opening.argument: The video presents XRP price forecasts as possibilities, not promised returns. The speaker calls the discussion “speculation,” describes the projected values as high and currently low-probability, and says the video is not financial advice. Although the description promotes a BTCC deposit bonus and discloses affiliate links, the supplied evidence describes no deceptive bonus condition, guaranteed return, credential request, or completed transaction. Speech attributes the discussion to Vincent despite a different title attribution; that discrepancy does not turn speculative market commentary into an observed solicitation.
